short: ' use' in the Apache licence header
notes: Card: ' use' 30 of the top 32, all in this licence. Probes: 1.01 with the Licensed line before it; 'you may not use this file' alone 0.06; 'not use a phone' 0.11; 'not copy this file' 0.26. So the licence context matters. Near misses keep the licence or 'you may not', and drop the verb or the licence.
